tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /thar rtse rdo rje 'chang gi sman sku'i nang bzhugs 'dod gsol dge/ oṃ swasti/ dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje dang mkhyen rab kyi mnga' bdag lha rigs 'od gsal 'khon gdung dpal sa skya pa zhes mtshan mchog gsum dang ldan pa'i rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pas dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang yi dam rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa sras dang slob ma bka' bstod dang bcas pa thams cad dgongs su gsol/ bdag ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang / tshe 'das ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams mthu stobs dbang phyug bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po gnyis kyis dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba dang / tshe 'dir rje btsun gong ma'i rigs rus khyad par can du skye gnas skal bzang thob nas chung ngu'i dus nas bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i gsol 'debs sogs la sbyong brdar dang / gong ma'i bka' srol la bzhugs pa'i sgrub dkyil bsgom bzlas dang / dge bsnyen dge tshul gyi bslab pa la gnas pa dang / byang sems kyi sdom pa bzung zhing sngags kyi sdom pas rgyud sbyangs pa dang / yi dam gyi lha rnams kyi grangs dus kyi bsnyen pa bgyis pa dang / sātstsha gtsug tor dri med kyi snying po can grangs mang btab pa dang / rje btsun gong ma'i bstan pa rin po cher 'dzin skyong spel gsum bgyis pa dang / nu bo de nyid nas kyang chung ngu nas bslab sbyangs 'dzin skyong spel gsum phran bu bgyis pa dang / khyad par kha 'don gyi rim par lam zab phyi nang / bir bsrung phyi nang / lam dus rgyas 'bring / dril bu nang dkyil/ gshed dmar lha lnga/ rdo rje 'jigs byed/ yang phur gur drag 'chi bdag 'joms pa/ tshe dpag med sprul sku/ gur zhal rnams kyi bsgom bzlas bgyis pa dang / dkar chab bzhi/ sil gtor brgya rtsa/ dbyug gu ma/ dzam dmar chu sbyin/

rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg chos srung gtor bsngo bskang ba/ sātstsha dri med kyi snying po can stobs che ba/ chab klu/ 'byung bzhi/ lan gtor/ gsur bsngo sogs mdor na kha 'don dge sbyor gyi rim pa ji snyed cig bgyis pa dang / gson dus su rim gro spong dag stobs che ba dang / 'das nas rjes sgrub dge ba grangs mang zhing khyad par rus tsha sku par gyi rigs shin tu phon che ba bzhugs gnas bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs kyi rten byang chub chen po'i mchod rten rgyu rin po che las grub cing tshad dang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs shing rten gyi bya ba mthar phyin bsgrubs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya chen po dang / bdag ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang / tshe 'das ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams mthu stobs dbang phyug bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po gnyis kyi dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa thar rtse rdo rje 'chang nam mkha' bsam 'grub kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po sku drin mtshungs pa ma mchis pa'i zhal snga nas kyi zhabs drung du zab pa dang rgya che ba'i dam pa'i chos rgya mtsho lta bur nos nas mgon po khyed kyi bka' drin bsab pa'i phyir gsung gi bdud rtsi thob pa rnams nyams su blang pa dang bka' bzhin bsgrub pa dang / gzhan smin grol la bkod pa dang / gdul bya'i dbang gis mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan nas kyang bde kyai gsang gsum gyi dkyil 'khor zab mo sgrub cing mchod pa dang / zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyis sgo nas gsol ba lan mang du btab pa dang / sku gdung rin po che la bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems kyi bsnyen pa phon cher btab pa dang / dus mchod la dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub cing gsang sngags rgya cher bzlas shing mchod pa phul ba dang /

bla ma gong ma'i byin rten 'dus sman 'dam las grub pa'i 'dren mchog dam pa nyid kyi sku bsnyen rten gyi bya ba yongs rdzogs mchod pa'i tshogs dang bcas bsgrubs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya chen po 'dis mtshon lus srog longs spyod dus gsum dge tshogs kun bzang mchod sprin rgya mtsho lta bur gyur nas drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa thar rtse rdo rje 'chang nam mkha' bsam 'grub kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po sku drin mtshungs pa ma mchis pa'i zhal snga nas gtso mdzad/ bla ma gong ma rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer ma mchis pa thams cad kyi thugs zag med kyi dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings su rdzogs nas skye ba dang tshe rabs thams cad du rjes su 'dzin par gyur cig de dag gi gnas skabs su bdag cag spun gnyis las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis mi shes pa dang / ma gus pa dang / bag med pa dang / snyoms las kyi dbang gis dam tshig dang sdom pa'i tshogs la nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs ji snyed mchis pa thams cad rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa de nyid kyi spyan sngar mthol lo bshags so/ /mi 'chab bo/ /mi sbed do/ /slan chad kyang sdom par bgyid do/ /mnyam med shākyā'i rgyal po'i bstan pa rin po che dang / khyad par rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig da lta zhal bzhugs pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams dang / khyad par drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas theg mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la sogs pa 'khrul zad skyes chen dam pa rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi nas sku tshe dang mdzad pa phrin las bstan 'gror sman pa'i bzhed pa thams cad rab tu rgyas shing yun du gnas par gyur cig

lha rigs 'khon sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud 'di la yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par sprul pa kho na rgyun mi chad par byon nas/ bod dbus gtsang gis mtshon pa'i gdul bya rnams la zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor te/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan bde mtha' dag 'bad med du stsol bar gyur cig de ltar byon pa rnams kyi'ang 'gal rkyen bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang / mthun rkyen sku tshe dang bsod nams gdung rgyud dpal dang 'byor pa lung rtogs kyi yon tan la sogs pa legs pa'i yon tan thams cad 'bad med du 'phel zhing rgyas te/ bstan 'gro la phan bde rlabs po che spel ba'i rgyur gyur cig sa phyogs ris gang na rgyal ba'i bstan pa bshad sgrub kyi sgo nas 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun sde gnyis ji snyed cig bzhugs pa rnams dang / khyad par chos grwa chen po thub bstan lha chen po/ bde ba chen po'i gling / dpal e waṃ chos ldan/ mi 'gyur rdo rje gdan/ bkra shis chos sde/ thub bstan rnam rgyal gser mdog can la sogs pa sa skya pa'i rje btsun gong ma'i bzhed gzhung 'khrul pa med par 'dzin pa'i dgon gnas thams cad du'ang dge 'dun rnams thugs mthun zhing khrims gtsang ba dang / mdo sngags kyi bshad sgrub dpal sa skya'i bla ma gong ma so so'i bzhed pa bzhin dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig bstan pa la mngon par dga' ba'i lha klu sogs mi ma yin pa'i 'gro ba rnams dang / bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chos bzhin du spyod pa'i rgyal po rgyal phran dbus dang mtha' 'khob gang na gnas pa thams cad dang / khyad par sde bzhi dge bcu 'dzoms pa'i yul grur rigs khyad par can las 'khrungs pa'i sa skyong chen po rnams la sogs pa sa skya pa'i bstan pa la bkur bsti dang rim gro byed pa'i sbyin pa'i bdag po thams cad kyi mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi nas bzhed don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub ste/

bstan pa'i zhabs tog yun ring du sgrub pa'i mthu dang ldan zhing / bdud dang mu stegs la sogs pa bstan pa la log par 'khu ba thams cad tshar gcod cing dpa' bkong ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur cig 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad dang / khyad par du yang dpal ldan sa skya'i mi sde shar nub gnyis kyis mtshon pa'i mnga' 'og thams cad du yang mi phyugs kyi rigs brgyud/ rin po che 'bru/ zas gos khang zhing la sogs pa nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang / nad mtshon mu ge phan tshun mi mthun pa la sogs pa nyes pa'i tshogs thams cad nye bar zhi nas/ char chu dus su phebs/ lo phyugs rtag tu legs/ kun kyang pha ma bu tsha lta bu'i byams pa chen po la nye bar gnas nas/ sngon gyi rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen phal po che/ khyad par sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma gdung brgyud zhal slob dang bcas pa rnams kyis 'debs par mdzad pa'i bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten dge 'dun gyi bzhugs gnas gtsug lag khang bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams gyi nyams pa gso ba dang / gsar du spel ba dang / yon gnas khyad par can rnams la rnam dkar gyi zhabs tog tshul bzhin du sgrub pa la sogs pa dge tshogs thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas te/ 'phral dang yun gyi phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'grub par gyur cig bdag ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang / tshe 'das ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams mthu stobs dbang phyug bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po gnyis la bka' drin che ba'i bsod nams dpal gyi dbang mo la sogs pa tshe 'dir 'brel thogs shi gson ji snyed mchis pa thams cad dang / 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa'i dus su 'brel thogs ji snyed gcig mchis pa de dag gis thog drangs sems can thams cad kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur cig

skye ba 'di dang srid pa thams cad du 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rgud pa thams cad dang bral zhing / 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'byor ba phun sum tshogs pa thams cad thob par gyur cig skye ba 'di dang srid pa thams cad du 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rgud pa thams cad dang bral zhing / 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i phun sum tshogs pa thob par gyur cig de las de de bzhin du gyur cig de las gzhan du nam yang ma gyur cig kā lya na wardhantu// ༈ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste/ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /sgrub la dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i/ /yi dam rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten thams cad na/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhugs pa yi/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad la/ /rtag tu gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /thog ma bar dang mthar dge zhing / /rnam par dkar la ma 'dres pa/ /nges par 'byung ba mchog gi lam/ /dam pa'i chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsod nams zhing rab mchog gyur pa/ /lha dang mi yi mchod pa'i gnas/ /rgyal sras rang rgyal dgra bcom pa/ /tshogs mchog dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal/ /tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan zhing / /ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par gnas/ /bde gshegs bstan pa legs 'dzin pa'i/ /bshes gnyen kun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod par 'os pa thams cad la/ /zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyis/ /lus btud pa yi rnam kun tu/ /mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod yon me tog bdug spos dang / /snang gsal dri mchog zhal zas dang / /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan rol mo'i sgras/ /bla ma'i tshogs dang dkon mchog mchod/ /'jig rten khams ni mtha' yas par/ /bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i/ /mchod pa'i yo byad ci mchis pa/ /blo yis blangs nas mchod par bgyi/

/rab dang yid las byung gyur pa'i/ /mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po ni/ /mkha' dang mnyam pa du ma yis/ /yon tan rgya mtsho sras bcas mchod/ /dman pa'i yul las rab 'das shing / /rgyal ba kun gyi dam tshig mchog /dngos grub kun gyi gzhir gyur pa/ /bdud rtsi mchog gi mchod par bgyi/ /sgrib pa'i dri ma kun bsal nas/ /rtog pa kun las rnam grol ba/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub sems/ /bde ba chen pos mnyes gyur cig /sa gzhi spos byugs me tog bkram/ /ri gling nyi zlar bcas pa 'di/ /skyabs gnas kun la 'bul bar bgyi/ /rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog /deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang / /dus gsum dge ba'i dngos po rnams/ /gus pas khyed la dbul bar bgyi/ /kun nas gzigs pa'i spyan ldan pa/ /yon gnas dam pa khyed rnams kyis/ /bdag la brtse bar nyer dgongs te/ /bdag gi 'di dag bzhes su gsol/ /bdag ni thog med dus nas su/ /las dang nyon mongs dbang gyur pas/ /lus dang ngag dang yid sgo nas/ /rang bzhin sdig pa ci bgyis dang / /sdom pa gsum dang 'gal gyur pa'i/ nyes pa'i tshogs kun rab 'gyod pas/ /mchod 'os rnams kyi spyan snga ru/ /slan chad sdom pa'i sems kyis bshags/ /bla ma'i 'phrin las rmad byung dang / /rgyal dang rgyal sras rang rgyal dang / /dgra bcom so so skye bo yi/ /dge ba kun la rjes yi rangs/ /'gro kun smin cing dgrol bya'i phyir/ /bla ma rnams dang sangs rgyas la/ /zab pa dang ni rgya che ba'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /sems can ji srid gnas kyi bar/ /mya ngan mi 'da' rtag bzhugs nas/ /'gro ba kun gyi don mdzad par/ /thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /bla ma mchog dang sangs rgyas dang / /chos dang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la/ /rnam pa kun tu bdag skyabs mchi/ /sems can kun gyi don slad du/

/rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob bya'i phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing / /byang chub spyod pa'ang spyad par bgyi/ /ye shes gsal ba'i spyan ldan pa'i/ /brtse ldan bla ma'i tshogs rnams dang / /rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa kun/ /yud tsam bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /ma rig pa yis ldongs gyur cing / /las kyi chu klung gis 'phangs pas/ /srid pa'i rgya mtshor lhung gyur te/ /nyon mongs chu srin dbang gyur cing / /mi bzad sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba'i/ /nyams chung blo gros rab dman pa/ /bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi/ /skyob pa mdzad par gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag cag rnams kyis rab 'bad kyang / /thar pa'i go skabs rnyed par dka'/ /khyod kyi thugs brtse'i phyag brkyangs nas/ /srid pa'i mtsho las bsgral du gsol/ /mngon par 'du byed kun gyi gzhi/ /tshul min yid la byed pa'i rgyu/ /ma rig mun pa 'thibs po che/ /ye shes zer gyis bsal du gsol/ /srid pa'i nyes kun 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /rtog pa thams cad bskyed byed pa/ /bdag tu 'dzin pa'i 'khri shing ni/ /shes rab ral gris gcad du gsol/ /kun rmongs kun 'khrugs kun nas dkris/ /nga rgyal dang ni phrag dog kun/ /mgon po khyod kyi mthu chen gyis/ /ye shes chen por bsgyur du gsol/ /srid pa thog med dus nas su/ /sems ni nyon mongs dbang gyur pas/ /bag chags dri ma gang bsags pa/ /ye shes chu yis sbyang du gsol/ /rang gi mngon par spyad pa'i mthus/ /rang la rang dbang med par ni/ /srid pa'i rgya mtshor 'phen byed pa'i/ /las kyi rlung shugs bzlog tu gsol/ /las dang nyon mongs kyis sprul pa'i/ /skye rga na ba 'chi la sogs/ /sdug bsngal 'du byed 'gyur ba yi/ /sdug bsngal zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /thabs dang skyabs dang dag pa dang / /theg chen nges par 'byung ba las/ /sems can rnams ni rab bslu ba'i/ /bdud kyi las rnams bzlog tu gsol/

/'jig rten pa yi don gnyer ba'i/ /rnyed dang bkur bsti la sogs pa/ /snying po med pa'i bya ba las/ /yid ni rab tu bzlog tu gsol/ /kun gzhi'i lte ba rab brtan zhing / /rten 'brel yan lag rtsibs bcu gnyis/ /sdug bsngal mu khyud gyis bskor ba'i/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo gzhig tu gsol/ /gzhan don la skyo bdag chags pas/ /rang nyid zhi ba don gnyer ba'i/ /nyan thos theg pa dman pa'i sems/ /rnam pa kun tu dgag tu gsol/ /bdag gi lus dang ngag dang ni/ /de bzhin yid kyi sgo nas kyang / /sems can kun la rnam kun tu/ /phan pa rgya cher 'byung bar mdzod/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sgrub pa la/ /phyi dang nang gi 'tshe ba yi/ /bar du gcod pa thams cad kun/ /nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /bshes gnyen grogs mchog dam chos dang / /gnas bzang ba dang yo byad sogs/ /rtag tu mthun pa'i rkyen rnams kun/ /lhun gyis 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ /tshe ring nad med 'byor ldan zhing / /'gro kun rtag tu 'dun pa dang / ji ltar bsam pa'i don rnams kun/ /chos bzhin 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ /tshe yi 'du byed gtong ba'i tshe/ /bla ma mchog dang he ru ka/ /mkha' 'gro'i dbang po dpag yas kyis/ /mkha' spyod gnas su bkri bar mdzod/ /lus srog longs spyod dngos kun gyis/ /skye zhing skye ba thams cad du/ /gong la dbang rab mchog thob pa'i/ /bla ma mnyes par byed par shog /skye ba 'di dang skye ba gzhan/ /skye ba'i 'khrul 'khor ma zhig par/ /gang dang gang du skyes gyur pa/ /ji srid sangs rgyas ma thob bar/ /de srid bla ma'i zhabs drung du/ /de yi 'phrin las sgrub pa dang / /ye shes gzigs pa 'jug pa'i phyir/ /'bral ba med par gnas gyur cig /mchod pa kun gyis mchod byed cing / /dngos po kun gyis mnyes byas nas/ /dngos grub rgya mtshos tshim 'gyur zhing / /dam chos rtag tu nyan pa dang / /bka' bzhin sgrub pa'ang byed par shog

/mang du smon kyang ci 'tshal te/ /dbang bcu ldan pa khyed rnams kun/ /ji ltar go 'phang mchog brnyes pa/ /de ltar bdag gis thob par mdzod/ /bdag gzhan srid pa'i sdug bsngal gyis/ /rnam pa kun tu nyams thag pas/ /mi shes bzhin du gsol ba la/ /nyes pa snang gang bzod par gsol/ /dge ba 'di dang dge ba gzhan/ /ma lus gcig tu bsdoms byas nas/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas myur thob shog /bdag ni tshe rabs thams cad du/ /rigs gzugs 'byor ldan shes rab dang / /dbang phyug phun sum tshogs gyur cing / /nad med tshe dang ldan gyur cig /sangs rgyas 'byung ba mnyes byed cing / /dam chos rtag tu spyod pa dang / /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /rnam pa kun tu mchod par shog /kun dga'i gsung rab rtag nyan cing / /sku yi rgyal mtshan blta ba dang / /de yi dpal 'byor bzang po yis/ /rtag tu bdag ni skyong bar shog /dad dang brtse dang brtson pa'i mthus/ /byang chub lam rnams rdzogs byed cing / /sangs rgyas zhing kun sbyong ba dang / /sems can smin par byed par shog /yid bzhin nor bu chen po ltar/ /bdag las sems can thams cad kyi/ /yid la 'dod dgu 'byung gyur zhing / /'gro kun tshim pa'ang byed par shog /bdag la brten nas 'gro ba kun/ /zab mo'i lam la rab zhugs nas/ /srid dang zhi la mi gnas pa'i/ /byang chub chen po thob gyur cig /blo gros sgrib gnyis rnam dag pas/ /shin tu zab pa'i blo gros dang / /rgya che'i blo gros dang ldan pa'i/ /blo gros chen por bdag gyur cig /tshul khrims rgyal mtshan dang ldan zhing / /chos kyi rgyal mtshan legs bzung bas/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan brtan byas nas/ /thar pa'i rgyal mtshan slong bar shog /tshogs gnyis dpal rab rdzogs gyur nas/ /'gro ba'i dpal mgon 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /sku gsum dpal 'byor lhun grub ste/ /srid zhi'i dpal du bdag gyur cig

/smon lam bzang po las byung ba'i/ /'phrin las bzang pos 'gro ba kun/ /skal ba bzang por legs bsgrub pa'i/ /brtul zhugs bzang por bdag gyur cig /dus gsum rgyal ba'i 'phrin las kun/ /bsgrub phyir 'phrin las sna tshogs pa'i/ /lus dang sprul par bdag gyur nas/ /'phrin las ma lus sgrub par shog /sras bcas rgyal ba'i 'phrin las kyis/ /kun nas 'dul bar mi spyod pa'i/ /gdul dka' ma lus 'dul ba yi/ /stobs kyi bdag por bdag gyur cig /tshe 'dir gnod pa'i dgra bgegs kyi/ /bsam sbyor gdug pa nyer zhi nas/ /lhag bsam dge ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /bdag gzhan don kun sgrub par shog /tshe ring ba dang nad med dang / /dpal dang 'byor pa phun tshogs pas/ /bstan dang 'gro ba ma lus pa'i/ /rtsa lag dam pa byed par shog /rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras rnams kyis/ /rjes su bdag kyang rab zhugs nas/ /dge ba 'di dang dge ba gzhan/ /thams cad yongs su bsngo bar bgyi/ /gzhan yang skye ba 'di nyid du/ /mi mthun phyogs kun zhi ba dang / /tshe ring nad med phun sum tshogs/ /rtag tu bde dang ldan gyur cig /bla med bla ma'i thugs rje dang / /rgyal dang rgyal sras rang rgyal dang / /dgra bcom bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /ji ltar bsngos bzhin 'grub par shog/ //ces pa 'di yang sa skya pa kun blos bla chen chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa'i lam 'bras phyag mchod chen mo'i spyi phyag gi mgor bla ma dang yi dam gnyis la spyi phyag re sbyar/ nang mchod kyis rjes su maṇḍal sa bzhi spos byugs ma tshig bsdur byas/ smon lam rnams kyi skabs su 'jug dgos pa rnams bla chen de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i chos rje'i thugs dam gnad bskul dang / 'jigs byed brgyud 'debs kyis mjug nas kha bskangs/ lus srog longs spyod sogs tshig rkang gcig nged rang gis gsar rtsom bcas sbyar ba ni thar rtse rdo rje 'chang sman sku bzhengs skabs 'dod gsol la phul ba yin pas slan chad gzhan gyis 'dod gsol 'jug tshe dmigs bsal bsgyur dgos skabs bstun shes par bya'o//
